quest.title: Orchard Repose
quest.description: Varesa accompanies you to her home, the Collective of Plenty, to introduce you to the local customs.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Mora x31125, Recipe: Cheesy Mushroom Skewer x1, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, you're here already!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Yep, my dad whipped up something fantastic as always. He's a great cook! He can turn any protein or vegetable into something delicious.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No wonder you look so refreshed! That's the power of a good meal!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Hehe, that's right! I was hoping to bring Uncle Acatl with me, but he wasn't home. So, I guess you're stuck with me.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Uncle Acatl is our chief, by the way! Who better than the chief to introduce you to the tribe, right?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I've never given an official tour before, so I'm thinking I'll just... explain things as we go along? Is that okay?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Of course! That sounds great.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Okay, whew... Then, let's start in... that direction!

talks.objective: Follow the path and hear what Varesa has to say

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: My place is over there! See that fruit stand out front? My house is right behind it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You have a fruit stand in front of your house? Does that mean you grow the fruit yourselves?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Hehe, you guessed it! My family runs a huge orchard.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: We live really close to the main entrance of the tribe. So, every morning, I wake up to the sound of all the people and carts on the road.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: That's also when my parents start work, so that's how I know it's time to get up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And then you all work in the orchard together.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: W—Well... Knowing it's time to get up and actually doing it are two separate things.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Most of the time, I end up curling under the covers and falling back asleep.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon gets you! Sleeping in is the best kind of sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Plus, when you have {NICKNAME} to wake you up, it's no big deal!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Next time, I'm sleeping in, and you can wake me up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #No, no! That was just a joke, heh... Don't scare Paimon like that, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Hahaha, well, maybe you can both sleep in sometime.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Once I get up, I usually help my parents around the house, head out for training, then come home for lunch.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: After lunch is when my parents do their delivery runs, so then it's my turn to work in the orchard.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That should be about now, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon would love to see the orchard! Can you show us?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Sure thing! We'll go right after this. But, first... come with me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're just doing some adventuring! We don't have any concrete plans.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We ran into Varesa on the road, and she was nice enough to lead us the rest of the way. She's even giving us a tour!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: It's my pleasure!

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Still keeping up with your training, Varesa? No slacking, I hope...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Yes, Coach! Did three full shuttle runs, just as you instructed, Coach!

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Good. Then, we'll continue with the training plan... As for your diet... actually, no dieting for now. As you are.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Feel free to use any of the equipment around here. But, if you're planning to do strength training, make sure you have a spotter.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Of course! Don't need to tell me twice, Coach!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, but isn't a special diet a huge part of body-building? Varesa doesn't need one?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Oh, it's kind of a long story... I suppose you could say Varesa is among the select few who have a natural gift.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: When she first started training with me, I started her on a standard training regimen and wrote out a simple recipe plan to give to her father.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: ...But, it left me so hungry, I couldn't even muster up the energy to make it to class.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Yeah, that was my fault. It was just your average nutrition plan, but Varesa's metabolism is something else.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Once I studied her eating habits, I was able to tailor it to her needs.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Yeah, Coach is really thoughtful that way! Now, I feel like I'm making real progress, and the training and classes are a lot more fun!

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Varesa is currently my top student... She can lift even more than me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, but... You're the coach! And a victor of the Pilgrimage!

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Hahaha, don't sound so surprised. This kind of thing is really common in the fitness world. Everyone starts from a different baseline.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, that's amazing! Paimon would have never guessed...

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: I'm not exaggerating, either. Varesa is extremely strong. All she needs is a bit more confidence...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Oh, well, it's just because Coach is a great teacher! Hehe, it didn't take much effort at all...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just further proof that you're a natural.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Oh believe me, I'm not. I mean, sure, I can face a few monsters and lift some heavy training equipment...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: But, I'm useless when it comes to fighting other people. I'm scared I'll hurt someone...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, that makes sense... But, what about the Pilgrimage?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: *sigh* I've never placed, or even made it out of the team stage. I'm not good at fighting actual people.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: When it comes to power, it's all about control. Take these weights, for example.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: It takes strength to lift them, yes, but also to control the weight when you set them down. True mastery means control during both motions.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I know that, and I can do it just fine during training. But, whenever I have to face a real person, I start to doubt myself...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Thanks, I appreciate the support. As long as I keep training, I'm sure I'll get it eventually.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: #Well, we should get going, Coach. I told {NICKNAME} and Paimon I would show them around the orchard.

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: Sounds good. I hope you enjoy your time here!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: This is where Coach Iansan lives. I heard there was some kind of incident at the Stadium, so she's not home right now.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: She asked me to do some upkeep on her equipment here, so we'll have to take a short break. It won't take long!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, there's all sorts of stuff around here... Is this all training equipment?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Sure is! It's all stuff Coach Iansan uses in her classes! She's taught me so much!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: If I'm being honest, though, I don't understand much of the theory behind it. I just do whatever Coach Iansan says and reap the payoff, hehe... She's amazing.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That means you're a natural!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, Paimon wants to try one of these! Can she?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Sure! Here, start with the lightest one.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *heave*...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nope, it won't even budge... You can actually lift these things?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Oh, yeah! It's pretty easy, actually... Coach Iansan is ordering me custom weights because these are too light.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, that's amazing! Paimon would have never guessed...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Oh, well, it's just because Coach is a great teacher! Hehe, it didn't take much effort at all...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just further proof that you're a natural.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Oh believe me, I'm not. I mean, sure, I can face a few monsters and lift some heavy training equipment...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: But, I'm useless when it comes to fighting other people. I'm scared I'll hurt someone...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, that makes sense... But, what about the Pilgrimage?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: *sigh* I've never placed, or even made it out of the team stage. I'm not good at fighting actual people.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Coach says, when it comes to power, it's all about control. Take these weights, for example...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: It takes strength to lift them, yes, but also to control the weight when you set them down. True mastery means control during both motions.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I know that, and I can do it just fine during training. But, whenever I have to face a real person, I start to doubt myself...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Thanks, I appreciate the support. As long as I keep training, I'm sure I'll get it eventually. For now... I just need to wrap up this maintenance.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: And, done! Sorry for the wait. Let's go check out the orchard.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Coach Iansan! Are you here to do some training?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Nope. Just doing some maintenance on the equipment here while I have some time.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you two! Welcome to the Collective of Plenty!

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Look! I bought this at the Stadium the other day.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, we've seen that graffiti design before!

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: It's not easy to get your hands on one of these! I had to wait in a super long line, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Ooh, I bought a top with that design, too! I hung it up right next to my bed, hehe.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Ooh, you should sign it for me sometime! It would mean the world to me!

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: Oh, I meant to ask, what brings you out here, anyway?

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: Hahaha, don't be shy! After everything you did for Natlan, you deserve the recognition!

talks.objective: Head to the orchard and talk to Varesa

dialogues.speaker: Vanana
dialogues.text: Roar, roar...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Good girl, Vanana! Thanks for guarding the house! Now, let me take a good look at you — did you have another growth spurt?

dialogues.speaker: Vanana
dialogues.text: Roar!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Haha, hey! I was just taking a look, not inviting you to wrestle! Next time, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Oh, this is Vanana. She keeps watch over the orchard when no one's here. She's a tough little thing, but also a clingy baby at heart.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, did you say... "little"? She certainly doesn't look it...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Anyway, this is my family's orchard. C'mon, I'll show you around.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, it's even bigger than Paimon imagined!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look at all the fruit! It looks delicious!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Hehe, this is the Collective of Plenty, after all. Being so close to the volcano makes the soil extra fertile. So, everything that grows around here is amazing.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Especially the fruit. We sell a lot to the other tribes, give some to family and friends, and keep the rest for ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, if you have to live next to a volcano, at least you get something good out of it!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: That's right! Since we're here, why don't we pick some and have ourselves a little snack!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, but didn't you just eat?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Yeah, but there's always room for dessert! Plus, we don't have to pick that many... A few dozen should do it!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Haha, you know that fruit stand in front of my house? Well, as a kid, whenever my dad was working at the stand, I would tug on his shirt and ask for a piece of fruit.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: I would scarf it down in a heartbeat and then ask for another. Before long, people would gather around just to watch.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: My dad told me I made the fruit look so delicious, more and more people started coming to our stand. Which, of course, made me want to eat even more.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: The customers would ruffle my hair and say, "It's good to have a healthy appetite. You'll grow up big and strong, for sure."

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: I mean, what kid doesn't like a compliment? So, I would smile, which would get my dad to smile, and then my mom, too...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aww, that's so cute! Plus, free fruit whenever you want? Jealous!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: With all that said, it also helped that our fruit actually tastes really good! And, I'm not just saying that — you'll see what I mean in a minute!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Oh, and there's an Epic Feast Showdown in a few days, so we're providing a bunch of the fruit for the desserts.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Epic Feast Showdown?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Oh, sorry! It's basically a speed eating contest. We need to prepare a ton of ingredients.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: So, don't worry about anything going to waste! Okay, let's get picking!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright! Hmm, where should we start...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Why is there a mushroom over there?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Oh, that kind of mushroom? They kind of appeared out of nowhere when we first planted the orchard.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: They grow really fast and don't require any water or fertilizer. Oh, and the flavor is amazing!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: You can grill them, stir-fry them, or even eat them raw! The flavor has almost a... fruity taste to it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A mushroom that tastes like a fruit? That's a new one...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Maybe it absorbed nutrients from the nearby fruit trees?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Yeah, that could be! Anyway, as far as I'm concerned, if it tastes like a fruit, then it fits right in! Who cares where it came from?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Go ahead! Pick as much as you want! Might as well get some mushrooms, too, and I'll whip up something to eat!

choices.text: You really can eat a lot, huh...

talks.objective: Pick some fruit and veg to prepare for the cooking

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Whoa, that's quite the haul!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, you need a bunch of ingredients for the eating competition, right? Thought we'd give you some help.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, and you were right about the fruit! Paimon tried one, and it was one of the sweetest, juiciest pieces of fruit Paimon has ever had! You must sell out every time!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Also Paimon tried one of the mushrooms, too! In a weird way, it really did taste like a fruit!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We should call them "berryshrooms"!

choices.text: When it comes to food, Paimon's judgment never fails.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, Paimon had multiple nations' worth of good food to refine her palate. Her tastebuds never lie!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Well, thanks to your help, we can call it early today. I promised you a meal, didn't I? I'll be right back!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Before long, Varesa places a piping hot mushroom dish in front of you.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: I'm not the greatest cook, so it's nothing special. Still, high-quality ingredients are hard to mess up.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't sell yourself short! It looks great! Paimon can smell the "umami" from here!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! This is completely different from the raw taste!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Hehe, I'm glad!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: This kind of mushroom is a favorite in the tribe. But, it's not well-known outside the Collective of Plenty.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Actually, we're hoping to use the upcoming competition to introduce it to a wider audience. Uncle Atolli has been coming up with new recipes like there's no tomorrow...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Hey, you two should sign up! Only if you want to, of course...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What do you think, Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, you mean the Epic Feast Showdown? ...Yeah! Paimon would love to sign up! She might not do very well, though...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Don't worry! You can tap out at any time. Nothing goes to waste. I'll take care of anything you can't finish.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, good... Wait! Aren't you competing, too? Then, Paimon doesn't stand a chance!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: You never know until you try! Besides, from what I just saw, looks like you can hold your own.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Anyway, winning isn't the point. Just think of it as an opportunity to try our local delicacies!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, good point!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Guess I'll tag along.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nice! Then, let's sign up together! Time for Paimon to show these people what she's made of!

choices.text: Every so often, Paimon knows what she's talking about.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, wait... Something tells Paimon that's not a compliment...

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Have fun around the tribe, you two! I'm gonna start my training for the day.

dialogues.speaker: Vanana
dialogues.text: This is Varesa's orchard... Must keep safe. No bad people or saurians allowed in.

dialogues.speaker: Vanana
dialogues.text: But you smell different. Very berry good friends, eat as much fruit as they like, no problem! Full tummy is happy tummy — Varesa says so too.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Oh, Coach Iansan! I thought it was time for the Pilgrimage. What are you doing back here?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Just stocking up on some battle supplies. I was running low.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Oh, hello there, you two. I think I've seen you around the Stadium before. You're the ones helping Kachina, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Yep! Paimon is Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: You're amazing! You helped Kachina improve so much in such a short amount of time! She's a lot more confident, too.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Her success in the Pilgrimage is the culmination of all her hard work. She should be very proud of herself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm sure she'd love to hear that from you in person.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Of course, just leave that to me. I know how important that is to her.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: So, what brings you to the Collective of Plenty?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Oh, Coach Iansan! Are you here to do some training?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Nope. Just doing some maintenance on the equipment here while I have some time.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Oh, hey there, you two. It's nice to see you again. We're happy to have you!

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: So, what brings you to the Collective of Plenty?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Go ahead! Pick as much as you want! Might as well get some mushrooms, too, and I'll whip up something to eat!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Hmm, I'll grab some of this... And a few of these ♪
